questions.question: A train crosses a 400 m-long platform in 50 seconds. It crosses another 600 m-long platform in 60 seconds. What are the length and the speed of the train?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Time taken to cross 400 m long platform = 50 seconds

Time taken to cross another 600 m long platform = 60 seconds

**Concept used:**

Time = **(Distance)/(Speed)**

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let the length of a train be x m

⇒ Putting the values in the formula,

⇒ 400 +x over 50 = 600 +xover 60

⇒ 60(400 + x) = 50(600 + x)

⇒ 24000 + 60x = 30000 + 50x

⇒ 10x = 6000

⇒ x = 600 metres

⇒ Speed = 400 + 600 over 50 = 20m/sec

⇒ For converting m / sec into km / h, multiply the value with (18)/(5)

⇒ So, 20 m / sec = 20times (18)/(5) = 72 km/h

** Hence, The length and speed of the train are 600 meters and 72 km/h respectively.**

questions.question: The curved surface area of a hemisphere is 1232 cm2. Its radius will be: (Take π = 22/7)
questions.solution:
**Given: **

Curved surface area of hemisphere = 1232 cm2 

**Concept Used:**

****Curved surface area of hemisphere = 2 π r²

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let the radius of hemisphere be r cm

⇒ Putting the values in the formula,

**⇒ **2π r² = 1232

⇒ 2 ×(22)/(7) r² = 1232

⇒ r² = 1232 × 7over 44 = 196

⇒ r = √196 = 14 cm

 **Hence, the radius of the hemisphere will be 14 cm.**

questions.question: The ratio of measures of the angles of a triangle is given as 3 ∶ 4 ∶ 8. What is the measure of the smallest of the three angles?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Ratio of the angles of a triangle = 3 : 4 : 8

**Concept Used:**

The sum of the angles of a triangle is 180°

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let the angles be 3x, 4x and 8x

⇒ According to the formula,

⇒ 3x + 4x + 8x = 180°

⇒ 15x = 180°

⇒ x = 12°

⇒ 3x is the smallest angle of three

⇒ 3x = 3 × 12° = 36°

** Hence, measure of the smallest angle is 36°.**

questions.question: If sin x - 3cos x = sqrt {3} cos x, then the value of cot x is ______.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

sin x – 3cos x = √3 cosx 

**Concept Used:**

cot x = 1over tan x

**Calculation:**

⇒ sin x – 3cos x =√3 cosx

⇒ On dividing both sides of the equation by cos x, we get

⇒ tan x – 3 = √3

⇒ tan x = 3 + √3 

⇒ cot x = 1 over 3+√3

⇒ On rationalizing the numerator, we get

⇒ cot x = 1 over 3+√3 × 3 - √3 over 3-√3

⇒ cot x = 3- √3over {3²-3} = (3-√3)/(6)

 **Hence, the value of cot x is 3- √3over 6.**

questions.question: The marked price of a refrigerator is ₹60,000. A shopkeeper offers a flat discount of ₹12,000 on full cash payment. Further he offers an extra discount of 5% on the marked price to his regular customers. How much does a regular customer have to pay on full cash for the refrigerator?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Marked price = Rs. 60,000

Flat discount = Rs. 12,000

Extra discount for regular customers = 5 % on the marked price

**Calculation:**

⇒ Amount payable after flat discount = Rs. 60,000 – Rs. 12,000 = Rs. 48000

⇒ Discount on Marked price for regular customer = 5 % of 60,000

⇒ Discount on MP for regular customers = (5)/(100)times 60000=3000 Rs

⇒ Amount payable by a regular customer for the refrigerator = 48000 – 3000 = Rs 45,000

 **Hence, the price that regular customer have to pay for the refrigerator is Rs 45,000.**

questions.question: Soham’s initial expenditure and savings were in the ratio 5 ∶ 1. His income increases by 25%, while his savings increase by 20%. If Soham’s current expenditure is ₹4,347, what was his initial income?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Ratio of initial expenditure and savings = 5 : 1

**Concept Used:**

Percentage

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let the Salary of Soham be Rs. 100

⇒ The ratio of expenditure and saving is 5 : 1, so

⇒ The expenditure = frac {5}{6} × 100 = Rs. (500)/(6)

⇒ The savings = (1)/(6) × 100 = Rs. (100)/(6)

⇒ After increase of 25 %, his new salary = Rs. 125

⇒ New Savings = (100)/(6) + 20 % of (100)/(6) 

⇒ New Savings = Rs. (120)/(6)

⇒ So, the new expenditure = 125 – (120)/(6) = 750 - 120 over 6 = Rs. 630 over 6 = Rs. 105

⇒ For the new expenditure of Rs. 105, his initial salary is Rs.100

⇒ So, for the expenditure of Rs. 4347,

⇒ Initial Salary = (100)/(105) × 4347 = Rs. 4140

**Hence, Soham's Initial Income was Rs. 4140.**

questions.question: A 25% profit is made when a discount of 25% is given on the marked price of an item. When the discount is 35%, what will be the profit? (Give your answer correct to the nearest whole number.)
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Profit = 25 %

Discount = 25 %

**Concept Used:**

S.P = C.P + Profit

S.P = M.P – Discount

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let the cost price be Rs. 100

⇒ There is a profit of 25 % on the item

⇒ So, Selling price = 100 + 25% of 100

⇒ Selling Price = 100+ (25)/(100) × 100 = 125 Rs.

⇒ Also, S.P = M. P – Discount

⇒ Discount = 25 % of M.P 

⇒ S.P = M.P – 25 % of M.P

⇒ 125 = M.P – frac {25}{100} × M.P

⇒ 125 = (3)/(4) M.P

⇒ M.P = 4 × 125 over 3

⇒ M.P = Rs. (500)/(3)

⇒ Now, there is a discount of 35 % on M.P

⇒ New S.P = M.P – 35 % of M.P

⇒ New S.P = frac{500} {3} - frac {35}{100} × frac {500}{3}=(500)/(3)-(175)/(3)

⇒ New S.P = Rs. (325)/(3) 

⇒ Hence Profit = (325)/(3)-100=(325-300)/(3)=(25)/(3)

⇒ Profit % = 8 (1)/(3) ≈ 8 %

 **Hence we can say that profit percent is equivalent to 8 %**

questions.question: What is the remainder when 8127 is divided by 8?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

8127 ÷ 8

**Concept Used:**

__Divisibility Rule of 8__

The divisibility rule of 8 for a 4 digit number says that if the last 3 digits of the given number are zeros or last 3 digits is divisible by 8 then the whole number is divisible by 8. 

**Calculation:**

⇒ In the case of 8127,

⇒ The number formed by last 3 digits is 127 and it is not divisible by 8

⇒ The lesser as well as nearest number to 127 which is divisible by 8 is 120

⇒ 8120 is divisible by 8

⇒ Thus, 8127 when divisible by 8 gives 7 as the remainder

**Hence, the remainder is 7.**

questions.question: If p⁴ = 4354 - (1)/({{p⁴)}} then the value of p³ – (1)/({{p³)}} can be:

(a – b)² = a² + b² – 2ab

**Calculation:**

⇒ p⁴ + (1)/(p⁴) + 2 = 4354 + 2 = 4356

⇒ ( p² + (1)/(p²) )² = (66)²

questions.question: Sunila drove her car at an average speed of 45 km/h for the first 75 km of a trip, and then at an average speed of 70 km/h for the remaining 45 km of the trip. If she made no stops during the trip, what was Sunila's average speed (in km/h) for the entire trip?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Speed of car for first 75 km = 45 km/h

Speed of car for remaining 45 km = 70 km/h

**Concept Used:**

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

**Calculation:**

⇒ Time taken for first 75 km = (75)/(45)=1(30)/(45) hours

⇒ Time taken for the remaining 45 km = (45)/(70) hours

⇒ Average speed for the entire trip = Total Distance ÷ Total time taken

⇒ Average Speed = (75+45)/(frac{75){45}+(45)/(70)}

⇒ Average Speed = (120)/(frac{75times 70 + 45times 45){3150}}=(120)/(frac{5250+2025){3150}}=(120)/(frac{7275){3150}}

⇒ Average Speed = (120times 3150)/(7275)=51(93)/(97) km/h

**Hence, the average speed for the entire journey is 51(93)/(97)km/h** .

questions.question: 8 + [16 – {7 + 4 – (9 of 3 + 6 – 4 × 7)}] =?
questions.solution:

8 + [16 – {7 + 4 – (9 of 3 + 6 – 4 × 7)}]

**Concept Used:**

BODMAS = Bracket, Of, Division, Multiplication, Addition, Subtraction

**Calculation:**

⇒ 8 + [16 – {7 + 4 – (9 of 3 + 6 – 4 × 7)}]

⇒ 8 + [16 – {7 + 4 – (27 + 6 – 4 × 7)}]

⇒ 8 + [16 – {7 + 4 – (27 + 6 – 28)}]

⇒ 8 + [16 – {7 + 4 – 5}]

⇒ 8 + [16 – 6] = 8 + 10 = 18

**Hence, the simplified value of the expression is 18**

questions.question: If the length and the breadth of a rectangle are increased by 15% and 20%, respectively, then by how much percent the area of the rectangle will increase?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Increase in length of rectangle = 15%

Increase in breadth of rectangle = 20%

**Concept Used:**

Area of Rectangle = Length × Breadth

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let the length of the rectangle be x and breadth be y.

⇒ Area of Rectangle = xy

⇒ Length after increase of 15% = x + 15% of x

⇒ New length = x+(15)/(100)× x = x+(3x)/(20)=(23x)/(20)

⇒ Breadth after increase of 20% = y + 20% of y

⇒ New breadth = y+(20)/(100)× y = y+(y)/(5)=(6y)/(5)

⇒ New area of rectangle = (23x)/(20)× (6y)/(5)=(69xy)/(50)

⇒ Increase in area = (69xy)/(50)-xy=(69xy-50xy)/(50)=(19xy)/(50)

⇒ Percentage increase in area of rectangle = (frac{19xy)/(50)}{xy}× 100=(19)/(50)× 100=38\%

**Hence, the percentage increase in the area of rectangle is 38% ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

questions.question: The sum of the length, breadth, and depth of a cuboid is 23 cm, and its diagonal is 5√7 cm. Its surface area is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Length + Breadth + Height = 23 cm

Diagonal of cuboid = 5√7 cm

**Concept Used:**

Diagonal of Cuboid = √{Length²+Breadth²+Height²}

Total Surface Area of cuboid = 2(l.b + b.h + h.l)

(a + b + c)² = a² + b² + c² + 2ab + 2bc + 2ca

**Calculation:**

⇒ Diagonal of Cuboid = √{l²+b²+h²} = 5√7

⇒ l²+b²+h²=(5√7)² = 175

⇒ l + b + h = 23

⇒ Squaring both sides, we get

⇒ l²+b²+h²+2(lb+bh+hl) = 23²

Putting the values,

⇒ 175 + 2(lb + bh + hl) = 529

⇒ 2(lb + bh + hl) = 529 – 175 = 354

**Hence, the surface area of the cuboid is 354 cm²**
